text.control:
The Tentacle is commanded to attack each time a target in 950 range gets hit by Harsh Lesson.

Its attacks get queued up if it receives more than one attack command. If the target of a queued attack dies before the attack starts, their dead body will be targeted. [https://youtu.be/V4QtaYHSVog] [https://youtu.be/EKSGdm-vnb8]

If the Tentacle is commanded to attack by a Harsh Lesson while inactive, it will instead queue the attack if it becomes active in the next 0.5 seconds. [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yLYMr3IZziU]

If a Tentacle is killed while attacking, the Tentacle will first finish its attack and then die, without being able to queue up other commands.
text.targeting: Minion (e.g interacts with I and I), but it does not interact with W.
text.onhit: Not mitigated by block or dodge.
text.spelleffects: Applies spell effects as area damage.
text.protection: A single spell shield can block all tentacle attacks that hit at the same time.
text.abilities:
;Slam
The Tentacle damages all non-structure enemies it hits along its length and heals Illaoi if it hits at least one enemy champion.

;Awakening
. If dormant for 30 consecutive seconds, the Tentacle disappears.

The Tentacle is lenient towards becoming dormant when Illaoi dies while the Tentacle is spawning [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0eQOqZiyM98] [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yLYMr3IZziU], or for 1.5 seconds after hitting Test of Spirit - allowing Tentacles to make a last attack on their targets.

;Enrage
The Tentacle is buffed by Leap of Faith.

;Vision
All Tentacles around 1000 range of an enemy champion are revealed through the fog of war.

When about to slam it reveals the targeted spot to allies.
